# 10.13.2026 Working with Population Genomics: Class 1

**Overview**

Today, we began working with VCF (Variant Call Format) files, which have two parts:

1.  Header: lines starting with \## that record how the file was made and define every field used in it

2.  Body: one line per variant

We ended with 3.5: Reading a variant record, and have not yet begun 3.6 in the tutorial for Day 1.

# 10.15.2026 Working with Population Genomics: Class 2
Today, we updated our .gitignore file to push our work from Class 1. We looked at the NIH (Natiional Library of Medicine), and in doing so, learned that we can find SRA Data for a species if we search for it. This is where we got the data for our VCFs. We learned that the pathway from last class was incorrect, so we updated it in the 10.13.2026 script.

We had to delete the new mydata files from Tuesday (which I did in the Vacc website under Files and then Home Directory) and add the corrected ones with this: 

cp /gpfs1/cl/biol3990/PopulationGenomics/VCF/*.vcf* /gpfs1/home/e/r/erewinke/projects/eco_genomics_2026/population_genomics/mydata

In Terminal: 

nano
